A.notes: Leaf-tipped progress bar with 'Step 1 of 3' label, clean illustration, strong heavy sans headline, good copy ('No account needed yet'). All gates pass per audit. Single sans family, welcome screen slightly template-like; mobile and desktop cohesive with blobs framing the centred phone card.

B.notes: More charming: mascot pot with face, Fraunces serif plus Nunito, device bezel on desktop, confetti, segmented progress. But G1 fails (white on #2f8f5b CTA 4.04:1; muted grey 4.31:1 on Skip and subcopy), 5 touch targets <44px, 4 h1 elements, 7 radii. Mobile has no frame/step label.

why: B is the more characterful design (mascot, serif voice, device frame) but fails the contrast gate on its primary CTA and Skip, capping it at 50. A is polished, passes every gate, and has clearer progress, so it is the one to ship.
